Vendored files (diffuse.webp, normal.webp, roughness.webp) are the
above originals resized 1k -> 512x512 and re-encoded as WebP (POLISH.md
item 5: "texture payload modest") -- a lossy transform of a CC0 asset,
not a distinct work, done for file size only. Re-download and verify
the MD5s above to check the originals if this ever needs redoing.

No attribution is legally required under CC0, but it's recorded here
for provenance -- this is a real, deliberately-chosen asset, not a
